subject: MUS
courseName: Applied Jazz Theory and Improvisation II

response.courseDescription: 258 Applied Jazz Theory and Improvisation II May be repeated for credit; cumulative maximum 4 hours. Applied study of intermediate jazz theory and improvisation concepts including five-part chords, modes of melodic minor scale, chord-scale theory, idiomatic jazz progressions, voice-leading, rhythm changes, bebop blues, and bebop scales.
response.coursePrerequisites: MUS 257 with a C or better.
